name: ECON 2301Q
title: Mathematical Economics
description: Application of mathematical techniques to economic problems. Methods studied: set theory, linear algebra, equilibrium analysis, unconstrained and constrained optimization, comparative statics, and linear programming.
requirement_description: ECON 1200 or both ECON 1201 (or ARE 1150) and ECON 1202; MATH 1071Q or MATH 1131Q or equivalent.
